skills.title: Database Deadlock Prevention
skills.description: Atomic techniques for preventing database deadlocks and lost updates.
guidelines: Implement consistent access order patterns to prevent circular dependencies
Design shorter transactions with precise locking scope
Use database-level atomic operations (like UPDATE counter = counter - 1)
Monitor queries using sp_WhoIsActive and deadlock graphs
Implement retry patterns with exponential backoff and jitter
Use database MVCC capabilities and explicit locking (SELECT FOR UPDATE)
Set appropriate isolation levels based on consistency requirements

skills.title: Cache Stampede Prevention
skills.description: Strategies for preventing cache stampedes and stale data issues.
guidelines: Use distributed locking with stale data fallback techniques
Implement probabilistic early recomputation (X-Fetch algorithm)
Apply request coalescing (single-flight pattern) using atomic Redis operations
Use tag-based invalidation for complex dependency chains
Implement version-based cache keys with automated rotation
Set appropriate time-to-live values based on data volatility
Monitor cache hit ratios and stampede indicators

skills.title: API Rate Limiting Edge Cases
skills.description: Handling bursty traffic and user-based throttling scenarios.
guidelines: Use sliding window algorithms instead of fixed window to prevent boundary attacks
Implement distributed coordination using Redis Lua scripts for atomic counters
Set up tiered rate limiting with different strategies per endpoint
Design graceful degradation patterns under overload conditions
Handle NAT gateways and IPv6 blocks with prefix-based limiting
Implement identity-based rate limiting with proper IP resolution
Monitor rate limiting metrics and adjust thresholds dynamically

guidelines: Implement idempotent producer design with sequence numbers
Use transactional message processing across multiple resources
Apply lease patterns for exclusive processing rights
Create atomic database transactions spanning message consumption
Implement proper acknowledgement patterns with retry logic
Monitor message delivery metrics and dead letter queues
Evaluate trade-offs between complexity and performance

Set up dead letter queue implementations with monitoring

Set up comprehensive alerting for critical job failures
